Objective: Research the release date of PostgreSQL 16 and identify its primary performance improvement.

Context: Simple fact-finding research. PostgreSQL 16 was released in 2023. The Owner needs the exact release date and the single most significant performance improvement introduced in this version.

Output contract:
- Format as markdown with ### headers exactly as deep-researcher-v2 normally produces
- Include the SOURCES section at the end
- Find the exact release date (day, month, year) of PostgreSQL 16
- Identify the single most impactful performance improvement (the one the PostgreSQL team and community highlight as the headline performance feature)
- Cite official PostgreSQL release notes or announcement as primary source

Evidence: Return URLs of PostgreSQL official release notes/announcement, plus any other credible sources that confirm the date and performance feature.

Boundaries: Only PostgreSQL 16. Not 17, not 15, not any other version. Only the release date and primary performance improvement.
